descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一个时空中的异常裂缝。我们越靠近，已知的物理相对论定律越不适用。

研究这一现象很可能将推动我们对宇宙机制的科学理解提升到一个更高的水平。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. The closer we get, the less the known laws of physical relativity hold purchase.

Studying this phenomenon could very well push our scientific understanding of the mechanics of the universe to a higher level.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.System.GetName]§!的一颗小行星内我们探测到了一个光亮四溢的物体。

由高度先进材料构建，它正在所有频率上广播稳定的无线电波。我们的扫描仪显示其内部没有含有爆炸性或挥发性化合物。看起来我们可以安全接近并进一步开展研究。
descriptions.en:
A brightly lit object has been detected on an asteroid in §Y[from.System.GetName]§!.

Constructed of highly advanced materials, it is broadcasting a steady stream of radio waves on all frequencies. Our scanners indicate no explosive or volatile compounds contained within. It seems safe to approach and study further.

descriptions.zh: 我们的扫描仪检测到了[from.System.GetName]恒星系中黑洞的物理特性与预期相比存在显著偏差。它的引力不可预测的，这导致空间中一个点到另一个点在时间上表现出显著的不一致性。
descriptions.en: Our scanners have detected significant deviations from the expected physical properties of the black hole in the [from.System.GetName] system. Its gravitational forces are unpredictable, resulting in noticeable temporal inconsistencies from one point in space to another.

descriptions.zh: 我们检测到§Y[this.GetName]§!地表上的自发爆炸！在没有在轨战舰或可探测到的地表生命的情况下，这些巨大爆炸的产生原因仍然未知。
descriptions.en: We have detected spontaneous explosions on the surface of §Y[this.GetName]§!. With no orbiting warships or detectable surface life, the cause of these massive blasts remains unknown.
